Alfred Travel — Your Trip, Your Way
Planning a great trip is about more than finding places to visit. It’s about creating a journey that works for your people, your pace, your interests, and your budget.

Alfred is your AI travel planner for building thoughtful, flexible itineraries. Start with a destination, your travel dates, and the kind of trip you want. Alfred helps shape the route and organise the days around the experiences that matter to you.

Plan around your real travel style
Whether you’re planning a family holiday, a city escape, or a multi-day adventure, Alfred helps you bring the pieces together:

Create personalised day-by-day itineraries
Plan around your family, group, interests, and pace
Add places, activities, restaurants, and must-see experiences
Explore flights and accommodation options
Balance big-ticket highlights with slower, easier days
Keep your route, timing, and travel details in one place
Edit and refine your itinerary as your plans change
Share your trip with the people travelling with you
More than a list of recommendations
Alfred helps turn travel ideas into a trip you can actually use. See how each day fits together, adjust the plan when priorities change, and keep the itinerary flexible instead of starting over.

From the first idea to the final plan, Alfred gives you a clearer way to shape your journey.

Plan less like a spreadsheet. Travel more like yourself.

Download Alfred Travel and start building your next trip.

record.name: Pogo: AI Trip Planner
record.offering: Travel app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Plan trips together, beautifully.

Pogo is the all-in-one trip planner for saving travel inspiration, building personalized itineraries, organizing reservations, and keeping every part of your trip in one place.

Whether you’re traveling solo, planning with a partner, organizing a group getaway, or coordinating a family vacation, Pogo makes it easy to turn scattered ideas into one organized plan.

PLAN TOGETHER

Create a dedicated Pinboard for every trip and invite friends, family, or travel companions to collaborate. Everyone can save places, add ideas, and help shape the itinerary - without losing links in texts, notes, screenshots, or group chats.

SAVE PLACES AND TRAVEL INSPIRATION

Pin restaurants, hotels, attractions, hidden gems, and must-see spots to your trip. Use Pogo’s AI-powered search to discover ideas based on your destination and interests, then save your favorites in a tap.

BUILD A PERSONALIZED ITINERARY

Turn your saved ideas into a clear day-by-day travel plan. With Pogo Magic, Pogo Plus members can generate a personalized AI itinerary tailored to their interests and travel style.

KEEP RESERVATIONS ORGANIZED

Add or import existing flight, hotel, restaurant, and activity reservations. Keep all your booking details alongside your itinerary, so everything you need is easy to find.

SEARCH HOTELS AND FLIGHTS

Explore hotel and flight options through Pogo’s travel partners, including Booking.com and Skyscanner, then continue with the partner to complete your booking. Save your plans and booking details to your Pinboard for easy access.

SEE YOUR TRIP ON A MAP

View all your saved Pins on a personalized map. See what’s nearby, group activities by area, plan routes, and visualize your trip at a glance.

PACK, PREP, AND GO

Create packing lists and travel checklists, and keep important documents such as boarding passes, tickets, and confirmations together in Pogo.

SAVE DREAM TRIPS WITH POGO POCKET

Not ready to choose your next destination? Save interesting places, travel ideas, and inspiration to Pogo Pocket. When you’re ready, turn those saved ideas into a new trip.

UPGRADE WITH POGO PLUS

Unlock Pogo Magic for personalized AI itineraries, plus custom categories, custom icons, and additional ways to personalize your travel planning.

Subscription options and pricing are shown in the app.

From weekend getaways and city breaks to road trips and once-in-a-lifetime adventures, Pogo helps you plan every journey from inspiration to itinerary.

Pogo is free to download, with optional in-app subscriptions.

Download Pogo and start planning your next trip.

---

Pogo Plus is available in a monthly or yearly subscription and allows you access to Pogo Plus-exclusive features, including the AI Itinerary, Custom Category and other features.

record.name: Steller: Travel Planner App
record.offering: Travel app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Steller is a travel planning app that makes finding the best things to do easy and planning your next trip stress fee. 


PLAN YOUR NEXT TRIP
Our trip builder combines AI and the power of the human experience to help you create the perfect trip. Hidden gems, the hottest spots on Instagram, the must sees – you can find, explore, and book them all in the Steller app. 

ASK BIRDIE
Birdie is your new trip planning assistant! Birdie knows all the best spots, local tips, and must-see attractions. She learns your preferences and tailors recommendations just for you. Need dining tips, outfit advice, the best time to visit, or safety tips? Birdie's got you covered! From spontaneous getaways to detailed itineraries, Birdie makes trip planning a breeze. Click + New Trip and tap the Birdie icon to start chatting!

SEARCH ANY DESTINATION ON EARTH
Search and find travel videos and recommendations for any destination. Whether you’re looking for travel recommendations you can trust in San Diego or Kathmandu — you’ll find them on Steller. 

BE INSPIRED BY A GLOBAL COMMUNITY OF TRAVELERS
Want to explore a new destination, but don’t know anyone who has been there? Each destination on Steller has videos from real travelers allowing you to see it from different perspectives.


BOOK UNIQUE EXPERIENCES & FAVORITES 
Whether you’re looking for a unique experience or the most popular attractions you can book it in minutes on Steller.

FIND YOUR TRAVEL FAM
Connect with people like you who love to travel and explore the way you do. 


THE MAP YOU’VE BEEN WAITING FOR
Zoom in on the Steller map to find something to do nearby. Map locations are infused with videos from real travelers giving you a sneak peek before you go. 


SWIPE UP FOR DETAILS
Wondering where a travel video is located? Swipe up to find the location, Google directions, and details about a place right inside Steller.


SAVE YOUR FAVORITES
Have a trip coming up? Save all your favorite recommendations, videos, places to stay, and things to eat to a trip. 

SHARE YOUR OWN VIDEOS
Took a trip and want to share about it? Ate at a restaurant that slaps? Had an experience you can’t keep to yourself? Upload a quick video and show the community.


BOOK A STAY
Places to stay at every price point. You may even discover some unique stays you won’t see anywhere else.


TRAVEL WITH CONFIDENCE
Reviews you can trust combined with videos from other travelers and the creators you love, means you’ll know what to expect before you go. Steller gives you all the information you need to feel confident in your travel choices.


USE THE MAP
If you’re looking for somewhere to eat or something to do right where you’re at — use the map on Steller to find something close by.


Terms of service — https://steller.co/terms


Privacy Policy — https://steller.co/privacy


Have feedback? Contact us at https://steller.co/contact

record.name: Iter: AI Travel & Trip Planner
record.offering: Travel app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Skip the trip everyone gets.
Iter learns how you like to travel. Then it plans the trip. No forms, no
forty open tabs: you know what you like when you see it, so Iter starts
there.
HOW IT LEARNS
Tap through photos and short clips of places and answer a few quick
questions. Every place you keep or pass on sharpens your Taste Profile.
START ANYWHERE
Type a place, a feeling, a budget or almost nothing. Suggestions arrive as
pictures. Keep or pass, and the trip takes shape in front of you.
SAME CITY, TWO DIFFERENT TRIPS
One traveler wants the Acropolis at opening time. Another wants no plan
before ten and a rooftop at dusk. Iter builds each itinerary around the
person taking the trip.
IT'S YOURS TO EDIT
Iter proposes. You decide. Swap a stop, slow a day down, add a hotel you
already booked or ask for another idea. Share it with whoever's coming.
THE WHOLE TRIP IN ONE PLAN
Days, hotels and estimated costs together, so you see the trip before you go.
Book tours and experiences through our partner Viator; book everything else
wherever you like.
BETWEEN TRIPS, ITER KEEPS LOOKING
Discover by vibe, from golden hour to markets and crowds. Iter shows you what
fits your taste and, on purpose, a little that doesn't. Taste should get
sharper. Not smaller.
YOUR TASTE ISN'T FOR SALE
What Iter learns about your taste is never sold, and nothing you're shown is
ranked by who paid to be there.
Free to start. Trip planning and your Taste Profile are free.

record.description_evidence:
TripShape – AI Travel Planner & Tour Guide

TripShape is an AI-powered travel planner, trip planner, city guide, and tour guide designed to make travel planning simple and personal. Choose your destination and travel dates, discover places you might love, and get a personalized travel itinerary based on your interests.

Explore Rome, Amsterdam, Istanbul, Ankara, Antalya, Izmir, Tbilisi, Batumi, Milan, Florence, and more. Discover things to do, tourist attractions, historical landmarks, museums, cultural experiences, restaurants, neighborhoods, and hidden gems all in one app.

AI-Powered Travel Planning

Choose a city and your travel dates, then swipe through photos to show us what you like. TripShape analyzes your choices and creates a personalized trip plan based on your preferences.

Instead of spending hours searching for things to do across different websites, get recommendations tailored to your travel style. Whether you enjoy history and museums, restaurants and local experiences, nature, popular attractions, or discovering lesser-known places, TripShape helps you find places that match your interests.

Your Personalized Travel Itinerary

TripShape creates a day-by-day travel itinerary that helps you organize your trip. See your travel route on the map, explore the places planned for each day, and easily follow your route while you travel.

Tap any location to learn more about it. Discover historical landmarks, museums, tourist attractions, restaurants, and other points of interest with short and useful descriptions.

Your City Guide and Tour Guide

Use TripShape as your city guide before your trip and as your personal tour guide while exploring. Discover the most popular attractions as well as local neighborhoods, hidden gems, and unique experiences.

Explore Rome's historic landmarks and museums, Amsterdam's canals and cultural attractions, Istanbul's historic districts and Bosphorus, Ankara's museums and cultural sites, Antalya's historical locations and natural beauty, and Izmir's coastal areas and local discoveries.

Discover Tbilisi and Batumi with recommendations for historical sites, cultural attractions, restaurants, tourist areas, and things to do.

Explore More, Plan Less

Trip planning often means searching through websites, saving places, creating restaurant lists, and building separate routes. TripShape brings these steps together in one travel app.

Get travel inspiration before your trip, discover places worth visiting, and create your own route. While traveling, follow your itinerary on the map and learn more about the places you visit.

Discover museums, cultural experiences, historical sites, restaurants, tourist attractions, and local experiences in one place. In selected cities, you can also discover music playlists that match the atmosphere of your destination.

Travel Your Way

Every traveler has different interests. TripShape uses your choices to personalize your recommendations, helping you create a trip that fits you rather than following a generic tour.

Whether you're planning a weekend getaway, a city break, or a longer vacation, TripShape helps you plan your trip, discover things to do, and make the most of your time.

From Rome and Amsterdam to Istanbul, Ankara, Antalya, Izmir, Tbilisi, and Batumi, discover new destinations and create a travel itinerary built around you.

TripShape brings AI travel planning, personalized trip itineraries, city guides, tour guides, travel routes, and travel inspiration together in one experience.

record.description_evidence:
Turn your travel ideas into a day-by-day itinerary, planned with AI and with the people you're travelling with. Everyone edits the same trip and everything stays in sync, from exploring destinations to bookings, tasks and expenses.

PLAN WITH AI, AT YOUR OWN PACE
Tell AI where you want to go, how long you'll stay and what you enjoy. Confirm your preferences, choose places and build a daily schedule step by step. Edit stops, times and transport yourself, or ask AI to make an afternoon more relaxed.

PLAN TOGETHER
Invite friends by email, or share a link or code. Everyone edits the same itinerary and sees changes in real time, discusses stops in comments, and shares checklists with assigned tasks. Give people edit access or view-only, and track and split costs in one place.

FIND YOUR NEXT DESTINATION
Browse destinations and place photos for inspiration. Explore sample itineraries in the trip marketplace, add one to your trips and adapt it to your plans.

SEE EACH DAY ON A TIMELINE AND MAP
Keep sights, stays and travel in view, including travel time between stops. Get a warning when a day is too tightly packed so you can adjust the pace.

KEEP BOOKINGS AND INSPIRATION TOGETHER
Organize flights, stays and restaurant reservations. Import booking drafts from text, PDFs, screenshots or calendar files (.ics), then review them before adding them to the trip. Save useful links for everyone to refer to and discuss.

SHARE TASKS AND TRACK EXPENSES
Use shared checklists and assign tasks to travel buddies. Record trip expenses, split costs or track purchases where everyone pays their own share.

TAKE YOUR ITINERARY WITH YOU
Trips you've opened are cached on your phone, so you can view saved content without an internet connection.

Free to start. AI features are subject to account and trip allowances.
